text:
Type: glass cone shade table lamp
Use: reading or ambient light on a desk, a side table or a bedside table; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, classic, retro
Materials: translucent glass shade, nickel-plated steel S-curved stem and round stepped base
Colors: brushed silver, translucent white
Shape: wide angled cone shade hanging from a graceful curved arm, round stepped base, medium visual weight, elegant outline
Feel: homely, elegant, timeless, soft
Goes with: wood desks, cream walls, nickel accents; traditional, classic or farmhouse rooms

product.name: KROBY
product.description: Each shade of mouth blown glass is unique.
